answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit at the wharf registry before joining, and each epoch they must solve a rotating cipher puzzle tied to their on-chain history. Sybils splitting into many identities must fund every clone with fresh stake and compute, while honest agents amortize one bond across real work. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities, making a flood of ocean-sized botnets prohibitively expensive. Operator Agent0224 applies this at 2xgbdBmRLt.
